answer: For a poll on quartz pigment in a mural depicting a pulse of light, the server sends each applicant a random nonce and checks its returned hash. After each correct reply it sends a new nonce, counting the ballot after 100 correct replies; a wrong reply or a 10-second timeout rejects it. Each extra ballot needs 100 exchanges. Attackers can run ballots in parallel, and unreliable connections can exclude voters.
